|buff = {{Name|Fishing|+1}} |duration = 4m 39s |dsvduration = 0439 |sellprice = 100 |recipe = {{CookingChannel|14 Fall, Year 1}} |ingredients = {{Name|Rainbow Trout|1}}{{Name|Green Algae|1}} |edibility = 40 }} '''Trout Soup''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. It can be purchased at [[Fish Shop|Willy's Fish Shop]] for {{Price|250}} and can randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]] for {{Price|50}}-{{Price|500}}, in [[The Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock for {{Price|200}}, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{tprice|100}}. It can also randomly be found in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon. One Trout Soup may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. '''Note''': this recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] without the [[Skills#Fishing|Angler profession]] - as then it will always result in profit when using the lowest quality ingredients. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy |hate=Evelyn |dislike=Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Trout Soup is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Recipes== Trout Soup is not used in any recipes. ==Tailoring== Trout Soup is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Ranger Uniform]]. [[File:Shirt241.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== Trout Soup is not used in any [[quests]]. ==History== {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}} {{History|1.5|Can now be prepared using a [[Cookout Kit]].}} {{NavboxRecipes}} [[Category:Recipes]] [[Category:Cooking]] [[de:Forellensuppe]] [[es:Sopa de trucha]] [[fr:Soupe à la truite]] [[it:Zuppa di trota]] [[ja:マスのスープ]] [[ko:송어 스프]] [[hu:Pisztráng leves]] [[pt:Sopa de truta]] [[ru:Уха из форели]] [[tr:Alabalık Çorbası]] [[zh:鳟鱼汤]]
